artworks.description: The image shows a seated person with a cup and a jug. The individual is sitting on a chair, holding a cup in one hand and a jug in the other. artworks.title: Seated Peasant with Jug

He has short, light-colored hair, wears a round, dark hat, a long-sleeved yellow shirt under a green vest, red trousers, knee-high socks, and dark shoes. The background is neutral with a shadow on the wall behind him.

artworks.title: Shipyard

The style is reminiscent of an etching with fine line work and a monochromatic color palette of warm cream and muted brown.

artworks.title: Shipyard

artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 × 6.3 cm (3 5/8 × 2 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene near a cabin. There are tall trees and a high horizon in the background. The monochrome palette has various shades of brown, giving a vintage look. The brushstrokes and shading provide depth to the picture. An upturned boat is near the shore with wooden beams scattered around. A simple wooden cabin is next to other buildings blending with the surroundings. Figures are near the structures, and tall trees with foliage form a border against the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Shipyard

artworks.title: Shipyard

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.medium: mezzotint with some burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30 × 24 cm (11 13/16 × 9 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up, facing slightly to his left. He has high cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, a moustache, and a goatee. His hair is styled with soft curls falling around his ears. He is wearing a formal outfit with a voluminous garment, large cuffs, and a wide white collar. His right hand rests at his waist, and the garment has buttons down the front. The background shows a heavy drapery on the right side, with the brim of a hat nearby.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man

artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man with his upper body slightly angled to the right. The sleeves of the garment are voluminous and gather at the wrists. In the background, there is a large curtain with a tassel hanging down, and a piece of furniture or object to the right. The background is shaded to emphasize the subject.

artworks.title: Woman Seated on the Ground with Two Children

artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 9.2 x 10.4 cm (3 5/8 x 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman and two children. The woman is depicted in a side profile, seated on her knees in a squatting position. She is wearing a headscarf, long dress with long sleeves, and is holding an infant wrapped in cloth. Beside her, an older child is seated with legs crossed. The background is textured paper.

artworks.title: Seated Old Man

artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man depicted from the waist up. His head is slightly turned to the left and he appears to be looking downward. He has a full beard and mustache, with a high forehead and thinning hair. He is dressed in a voluminous robe with flowing lines. The background is plain with a neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: red chalk
artworks.description: A man with a rounded nose and wide, soft jawline looks out at us in this almost square red-chalk drawing. The man’s shoulders angle to our right, and he turns his face to us, his heavy-lidded eyes shadowed under a floppy beret. His thin lips are closed, and he has a goatee. Curly hair frames his face, and one long lock falls over his right shoulder, to our left. A light-colored collar, perhaps lace, lies across his shoulders over a darker garment.
